protocol.name: uq-component-ablation-20261014-v1
protocol.randomization: within-class row permutation; identical logit scale/capacities
protocol.access: current-delta-only; own frozen synthetic prefix; zero historical raw reads
protocol.synthetic_topology: none; common raw transductive inference graph
protocol.primary_split: sealed_test; report_dev stored separately; post-hoc diagnosis, no tuning
protocol.payload_control_scope: fixed-X storage-only, not an end-to-end text construction ablation

audit.objective: Q-derived X/text/topology with multimodal gradient and propagation matching

distribution_matching.target_scope: current-delta rows of legal reference one-hop messages
distribution_matching.synthetic_scope: current slots after materialized synthetic one-hop propagation
distribution_matching.reduction: sum over classes/features, mean over random Encoder bank

joint_pair_distribution.kernel: product of fixed normalized ReLU random-feature kernels
joint_pair_distribution.reference_scope: current-delta legal one-hop message and exactly materializable text candidates
joint_pair_distribution.shuffling_scope: new target statistic only; candidate pool, initialization and source IDs unchanged

audit.topology_operator: binary simple undirected + one self loop; Student normalization
